ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Human Services
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota Human Services system to identify potential areas of fraud and abuse
questions: How much money is allocated to the Minnesota Human Services system?
What are the most common types of fraud and abuse in the system?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the flow of funds and identifying potential areas of fraud and abuse, we can gain a better understanding of the scope of the problem and where to focus our investigation.
